name: Asa - Hultsjö
description: Asa to Hultsjö. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: The main HÖ11 trail card is filed under Jönköpings län/Sävsjö, but official endpoint evidence puts Asa/start in Kronobergs län/Växjö and Hultsjö/end in Jönköpings län/Sävsjö.
Whole-trail topology treats HÖ11 as part of the main loop, while the stage itself is point-to-point from Asa to Hultsjö.
Current official side-trail API reports 0.1 km; older municipal PDF wording indicates about 200 m.
Older municipal PDF says waste stand, while the facilities lane found a shelter-app report saying no trash can.
HÖ12 and recent field context support water at Hultsjö church/cemetery, but the HÖ11 page itself names only Asa herrgård for water.
Rules lane overlay found Övingen Natura 2000 about 2 m from sampled GPX but not strictly intersecting it.

facilities.name: Asa ledentré HÖ10/HÖ11
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ10/HÖ11 entrance at Asa. Also connects to Sigfridsleden toward Växjö. Shared endpoint with HÖ10 and Sigfridsleden connection. Ledentré page does not directly list parking or water.

facilities.name: Övingen vindskydd
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan/Smålandsleden marker; OSM shelter corroborates nearby at 57.237758, 14.716152
facilities.description: Official shelter by Övingen, named in the HÖ11 stage description as an overnight option. Field and iFiske sources support a remote lake-side setting. No official toilet, potable water, bin or firewood was verified at Övingen. Lake water is not potable unless treated. The Övingen Natura 2000 boundary is effectively adjacent to the route corridor.

facilities.name: Avstickare Hultsjö/Slagetorp vindskydd
facilities.description: Official side trail from HÖ11 toward the Hultsjö/Slagetorp shelter near the end of the section. API length is 0.1 km, while older municipal PDF wording suggests about 200 m. Model as side/access metadata, not as part of the HÖ11 main geometry.

facilities.name: Hultsjö/Slagetorp vindskydd
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan/Smålandsleden marker; OSM shelter and firepit corroborate nearby
facilities.description: Official Hultsjö/Slagetorp shelter reached by the signed side trail near the north end of HÖ11. Access is via the official side trail. No official toilet or potable water was verified. Waste handling is contradictory: older municipal PDF mentions a waste stand, while Vindskyddskartan reportedly says no trash can.

facilities.name: Hultsjö ledentré HÖ11/HÖ12
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ11/HÖ12 entrance at Hultsjö. Shared endpoint with HÖ12. Nearby Hultsjö church/cemetery water is supported by HÖ12/field context, not by the HÖ11 page itself.

facilities.name: Asa Herrgård
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 5035982746 and Asa Herrgård official site; HÖ11 official page for drinking-water statement
facilities.description: Commercial manor/lodging/restaurant near the Asa start. The official HÖ11 description says drinking water can be refilled at Asa herrgård. Water/service may depend on opening hours, business operation or permission. Do not model as an always-available public tap without confirmation.
